limitations.note: The agent fixed the counter but also removed the `ready_b` condition, changing whether `data_out` reloads or keeps accumulating when a group starts while downstream is not ready.

The scoreboard assumed each group starts a fresh sum regardless of `ready_b`, so the backpressure tests validated the extra behavior change instead of catching the mismatch with the original accumulation logic.
